findings.finding: Persian/Spanish full descriptions strengthen no cloud lock-in to no cloud dependence, while the source and the same dossier limits allow configured OpenAI/Anthropic extraction.
findings.recommendation: Translate vendor lock-in/local storage precisely and retain the external-provider caveat; do not promise offline extraction.

findings.finding: Dossier correctly qualifies hash lookup/cancellation as expected O(1); article takeaway, direct-lookup paragraph and unordered_map table omit the expected/average-case qualifier in English and all four translations. Machine corpus/search inherit the article takeaway.
findings.recommendation: Use expected/average hash complexity consistently; keep list erase and free-list operations distinct from hash worst-case behavior.

findings.finding: Security article states Gemini is the only outbound egress, despite the same article discussing GitHub tokens and the product being a remote Git client. This exclusivity is absent from the dossier and needs checking against pinned Git/GitHub integration.
findings.recommendation: Remove exclusivity or enumerate actual Git/GitHub/provider egress after source-owner verification; do not assert network isolation from token storage controls.

findings.status: confirmed wording disagreement; actual implementation deferred to source owner
findings.finding: Dossier proof names perf-buffer transport; article data path says ring buffer twice. These can mean different BPF transports, so source should decide which description is current.
findings.recommendation: Use the actual pinned transport consistently, or explain separate stages if both are used. Do not infer a runtime benchmark from the terminology.

findings.finding: Header and machine prose distinguish current software DOI21737792 from older paper20374849, but the SoftwareSourceCode JSON-LD node has no identifier/sameAs for links.doi; only older ScholarlyArticle DOI nodes are modeled.
findings.recommendation: If extending machine identity, add the software DOI as the software entity identifier/sameAs without recasting it as a ScholarlyArticle or changing original paper dates.
